name: 16725-guidedjsonpattern-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One engine process.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, bounded at 8 requests -- ONE round of the eight streams -- with a 1200 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% (2 warmup, 6 measured). The request count is set by RUNTIME, not by sampling: every admitted request adds tens of seconds of single-threaded host CPU to the wall clock before the engine steps, so one round is what the run can afford. See configs/tuned.yaml on the engine-iteration timeout, without which the engine dies before the first token.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets, seed 8317. Prompt EXACTLY 128 tokens (min = max = 128). `temperature` 0.0; `ignore_eos` FALSE, so a request ends when the constrained document is complete; `output_tokens` 1408 is a CAP the constraint terminates before, ~14% above the roomiest conforming document. `request_format: plain` is required -- the default `default-template` asks this engine generation's tokenizer wrapper for a chat template it does not have, which errors every request and reports 0.0 on every metric rather than failing. Every request carries the SAME JSON schema, declared at `spec.backend.sampling_params.structured_outputs.json` in configs/scenario.json: 16 required probe groups of 6 required fields, `additionalProperties` false throughout, 96 constrained leaf values, ~1020 generated tokens per conforming document.
purpose: A structured diagnostic report generator on one GPU, eight concurrent users sending 128-token prompts for schema-conforming JSON.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
